dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Another escort mission? I've lost count of how many of these I've done...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Isn't there some commission that will really let me show off what I can do?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Everything in good time, Anna. Don't be so hasty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I've been taking my progress as an adventurer quite... slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I've completed some escort missions, more escort missions... Have I mentioned the other escort missions?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: And she's very good at them, too.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: As I see it, she is already an expert at these commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Brother! I've done this escort so many times already! I'm looking for something more exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Come on, Anna. Everything in good time.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been feeling, Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Me? I'm feeling great! In fact, I feel almost indefatigable!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Something that's shown through in your appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Brother! I... I'm only eating a bit more than I used to, come on!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Don't you pin this on me, by the way. This is your fault for making the food so delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: And what would you like to have for dinner tonight?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Sweet Madame, Pancakes... and Chicken-Mushroom Skewer! And, and... Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Alright, see you.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: See you. Um, and also...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Not bad for today...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: What are you doing!? You frightened me!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: What are YOU doing?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I... I'm not doing anything.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Oh, well. You've caught me already, haven't you...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: It's just an ordinary water fountain, but somehow people treat it like a wishing well...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Throwing their money away for nothing... But I could use that money!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I am in desperate need of money... Please don't tell anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you need the money?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Because of Anna, my sister. You may have met her during the day.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: She's suffering from a rare disease, so she often comes here to make wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Why does it have to be her... She's such a kind and gentle kid... Why must it be her and not me...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: These coins somewhat make up for the medicine she needs, but I also work hard at my job, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: If the archons are watching... I'm sure they will forgive my actions...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thanks to that master physician, Anna's finally turned the corner...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is Anna doing well?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thanks to that doctor, Anna's been getting better.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: She hasn't made a full recovery yet, but that doctor also gave me a recuperative prescription for her.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: As long as she keeps taking her medicine, she will eventually get well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what are your plans going forward?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Me? Well, since Anna's illness has been taking a turn for the better, I can probably take some more relaxed work as compared to before.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I was really busy then, and didn't have time to spend with Anna at all. I have to change that.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Unless you mean my picking Mora at midnight — in which case, well, every little bit was a gain. But I won't do that anymore. I only did it then on account of my younger sister's illness, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been tough on you.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Hahaha, this is nothing. I would do anything for Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: To be honest, I have to thank you again. If not for you, I wouldn't have been able to gather those strange ingredients for that prescription.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Once Anna fully recovers, I should invite you over to taste some of her cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll look forward to it.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: See you!
